D.t: Maggie Goodlander leads by 20.1 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 69,165 votes; a one point swing is about 1,721 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +12.2 and D +27.8. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$2.4M cash against $663K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
